figurative_meaning_en: The dignity and prestige associated with high office or authority
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি তার পদগৌরবের জন্য সবাইকে আদেশ দেন।
পদগৌরব না থাকলে কাজ চলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He commands everyone due to the prestige of his position.
Without the dignity of office, the work doesn't proceed.
note: Refers to bureaucratic or hierarchical respect in Bengali society
